name: AlphaX POS Menu
description: What a place sells. Menus are the ONLY thing that decides which items appear on a till. Item groups stay a merchandise taxonomy (what a thing is); menus are the sales channel (where it is sold). Keeping those apart is what lets two branches of the same brand carry different ranges without ever reorganising the item tree.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Blank means every company on this site.

fields.label: Price List Override
fields.description: Applies to items reached through this menu. Blank uses the outlet's price list. This is how a delivery or airport-branch menu carries different pricing without a duplicate item master.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: When several menus stack, the highest priority supplies the price for an item they both contain.

fields.label: When It Is Available
fields.description: Leave blank for always. A breakfast or Ramadan menu is a time window, not a separate outlet.

fields.label: Days
fields.description: Comma-separated: Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri,Sat,Sun. Blank means every day.

fields.label: Items Resolved
fields.description: Recomputed on save. Zero means the rules match nothing — usually an item group with no sellable items under it.
